label: MORE_1 control: strict comparative holds, no-effect-exceeds-total-cause fails
description: MORE_1 side of the comparison: on two beings that totally cause each other, with the primitive comparative true of every ordered pair, the strict comparative and more-such-has-the-perfection hold while 'no effect is more r than its total cause' fails. So the Cartesian 'at least as much', read on the primitive comparative, is not a weakening of the Aristotelian strict comparative without an asymmetry premise for MoreIn. A finite interpretation only; it does not say MoreIn is symmetric.
